remarks: YOUR HORSE. YOUR BARN. YOUR VISION. Set on more than 7 level acres in the heart of Fairfield County, 80 to 90 Comstock Hill Avenue presents a rare opportunity to own an established equestrian estate with exceptional scale, flexibility, and a unique combination of land, location, and infrastructure. Whether your vision is a training facility, elite boarding operation, equestrian wellness retreat, family farm, or private compound, this property provides the ideal foundation. The existing equestrian amenities offer immediate functionality while creating opportunities to thoughtfully tailor the estate to your own lifestyle and long-term goals. Ideally situated just one hour from Manhattan and minutes from Westport, New Canaan, Wilton, Darien, and Rowayton, the property offers the serenity of country living with exceptional access to Fairfield County's most desirable communities. Whether you preserve its equestrian legacy or shape its next chapter, 80 to 90 Comstock Hill Avenue represents one of Fairfield County's most compelling opportunities to create a truly exceptional estate.
